text:
Nina: Evening all — I'm putting together a low-key playlist for late-night coding that feels like a movie score but isn't overused. Any under-the-radar soundtrack or album recs?

Kai: Oh nice. A couple personal faves: 'A Winged Victory for the Sullen' — great ambient, very cinematic but chill.

Zoe: Also +1 for Mica Levi's less obvious stuff (not just Jackie). Their solo ambient pieces pair super well with coffee & terminals.

Marco: If you want something string-forward and weird: check out Jóhann Jóhannsson's earlier EPs — more experimental than the big film stuff.

Lina: For non-classical but cinematic vibes, try the Soundtrack to the game 'What Remains of Edith Finch' — really haunting and underrated.

Kai: Throwing an oddball in: 'Sault' has tracks that feel like a period drama score but are contemporary.

Nina: Love these. Any suggestions for synth-heavy late-night stuff? Something like Blade Runner mood but quieter.

Marco: Colin Stetson + Ben Frost collaborations are brutal/beautiful — not mellow but intense in a good way. For quieter synth: Tim Hecker's "Virgins" album is excellent.

Zoe: For analog synth warmth try Susumu Yokota — his stuff is all over the place but some albums feel like nocturnal soundtracks.

Lina: Quick cross-media rec: the novel 'The Flamethrowers' reads like a film — pair with Angelo Badalamenti-ish instrumentals.

Kai: If anyone wants a starter playlist, I made a short curated list: spotify:playlist:37i9dQZF1DX4sWSpwq3LiO (saved as a share link here).

playlist-bot: I curated a 1-hr mix named 'Quiet Cinematics — Redwood' and added tracks from this thread — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0QxExample (auto-generated) :robot_face:

Nina: haha thanks bot. Reaction poll: drop an emoji to vote — 🎧 for music, 🎬 for movies, 📚 for books that feel cinematic.

Marco: 🎧

Zoe: 🎧

Lina: 📚 (recent rec: 'The Flamethrowers')

Kai: 🎧 +1 for Tim Hecker suggestion.

Nina: OK playlist assembled, thanks everyone. If you stumble on obscure film composers (especially female/POC composers) tag me — trying to diversify the mix. :heart:

Zoe: also, random rec: 'The Fall' (film) soundtrack by Alexi Murdoch — gentle and underrated.

Marco: adding 'The Fall' to queue. If anyone wants a lightweight export of the playlist as .m3u I can drop it here.

Nina: That'd be cool Marco, thanks.

Kai: quick note — please include timestamps for track start if you do the export, makes jumping in easier.

Marco: Will do, will post later today.

Lina: Thank you all — perfect background for tonight's bug sweep. :coffee:

Nina: Appreciated!
